temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia appears more withdrawn than usual during their shifts; she says it is personal stuff when Jose asks, thanks him for asking, and appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is generally vibrant and seems to be doing okay at work; Jose has not been aware of any serious trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His suspicion that something may be troubling Patricia is activated and supported by her withdrawn behavior and vague reference to personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be dealing with a personal problem; she is not ready to share details but appreciates Jose's offer of support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, sympathetic, and cautious about respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be available as a supportive listener and gently check in without pressuring her to disclose.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; when he offers to discuss financial planning, she confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and may take him up on budgeting tips.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is dealing with an unspecified personal problem; she appreciates Jose's support but has not shared details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. The vague personal concern is now more specifically identified as financial stress, and she seems receptive to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is stressed by bills and financial commitments and may be open to discussing budgeting or financial planning with Jose.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, empathy, and a wish to be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer practical financial planning or budgeting help when Patricia is ready and to continue supporting her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose worries he may have overstepped by raising financial planning; he checks with Patricia, who reassures him he was not prying and says she is grateful for his offer. He reiterates that he respects her privacy and wants to support her as a friend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is financially stressed and may be receptive to help, but Jose is worried that his financial-planning offer might have felt intrusive or boundary-crossing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Patricia's reassurance resolves his worry: she does not think he overstepped and instead values his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern, does not view him as intrusive, and sees him as a supportive friend; he can support her while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry turning to relief and reassurance; still caring.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To remain a supportive friend, respect her privacy, and be available if she wants help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia gives a general, positive update and mentions a quiet weekend at home without sharing details; Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support, does not think he overstepped, and is dealing with financial or personal stress; Jose wants to be supportive without prying.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, mainly as a refinement or reinforcement: he recognizes that Patricia values his concern while preferring privacy and low-pressure contact.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but wants to handle her issues privately; she knows he is available if she needs him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, care, and sensitivity to her boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain a supportive but non-intrusive presence, check in casually, and let Patricia initiate deeper conversations or requests for help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling things; she thanks Jose for checking in and says it is great to have his support. She does not ask for specific help or share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support but prefers to handle her issues privately; Jose should remain available without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; the interaction reinforces that Patricia is managing, values his supportive presence, and is comfortable with friendly check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation, appreciates his ongoing support, and knows he is available; Jose can continue low-pressure check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Supportive, friendly, and reassured that his presence is welcomed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue regularly checking in, offering help or coffee if needed, and maintain a supportive coworker and friend role without overstepping.
